title: Language and Undertow
author: Jonah Yarrow
blurb: Ansel Galloway, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return to the place where the story went wrong before the demolition date arrives.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
